description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class for testing LDAP connections within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for validating input data, performing LDAP connection tests, and reporting the status of LDAP authentication and user lookup checks.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for testing LDAP connections, providing functionality to validate connection parameters, execute LDAP connection tests, and report statuses including authentication and user lookup results.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; intended to retrieve all LDAP test results.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; intended to provide validation rules for retrieving all LDAP test results.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Processes a request to test an LDAP connection based on provided configuration, validates input, and returns the test results including authentication and user lookup status.

methods.name: getLDAPTestService
methods.description: Creates an instance of LDAPTestService for testing LDAP connectivity with the provided settings.

methods.name: getLDAPTestSyncService
methods.description: Creates an instance of LDAPTestSyncService for synchronizing LDAP user data with the provided settings.

methods.name: getNormalizeLDAPSettings
methods.description: Performs LDAP authentication and user search tests, assembling and returning a status report including counts of users found or imported.

methods.name: setConfigAttributes
methods.description: Configures LDAPSetting object with connection credentials, including handling anonymous bind scenarios.

methods.name: setDataMappingAttributes
methods.description: Assigns attribute mappings to the LDAPSetting object based on provided data mapping configuration.

methods.name: setUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Adds user lookup configurations to the LDAPSetting object from provided settings.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create API operation, excluding certain parameters.
